description.value: A casual sushi restaurant offering combos, sashimi, and entrees with generous portions. Recently rebranded from Samurai Sushi on Cambie, it's a straightforward spot for quick, affordable sushi on Cambie Street.

This is a real, open restaurant suitable for inclusion as a food resource.
